label: Activations
help: What each layer produced for this token. Each pixel shows one captured value.

label: Weights
help: RMS magnitude of fixed weights in each block. This view stays fixed during ordinary generation; it does not measure importance.

label: Weight × input
help: How fixed weights combine with this token’s inputs. The overview shows RMS product magnitude, not causal importance or signed cancellation.

label: Attention
help: Attention probabilities reconstructed from captured queries and stored keys. These are not kernel bit-exact results or causal attribution.

label: KV memory
help: Attention memory written for earlier positions. Missing captures are marked, never treated as zero.

label: Recurrent memory
help: Block RMS of state after captured chunks. Intermediate prompt states inside a chunk were not captured.
